bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.WebhookSignatur.description:
WebhookSignature says how a source signs its webhook deliveries, so the
 core can check them before the adapter sees them.

^(signatureHeader)$.description: The header that carries the signature.

^(signaturePrefix)$.description: Text before the signature in that header, such as "sha256=".

scheme.description:
The scheme, as a model.v1alpha1.WebhookScheme name, such as
 "WEBHOOK_SCHEME_HMAC_SHA256".

signature_header.description: The header that carries the signature.

signature_prefix.description: Text before the signature in that header, such as "sha256=".

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.WebhookSignatur.title: Webhook Signature
